What a shower
project includes

Everything below is planned, priced
and built by our own crew.

  • Walk‑in showers

    Curbless or low‑curb showers with glass.

  • Steam showers

    Sealed enclosures with a steam generator.

  • Waterproofing

    A waterproof membrane behind every tiled wall and floor.

  • Niches and benches

    Built‑in niches and seats, tiled to match.

  • Heated floors

    Electric radiant heat under the new tile.

  • Glass and fixtures

    Frameless glass, valves and shower heads.

From estimate
to first shower

How a shower project runs,
step by step.

  1. 01

    Design and estimate

    We measure, pick the layout and finishes with you and send a written estimate.

  2. 02

    Ordering

    Tile, glass, valves and heating mats ordered before demolition.

  3. 03

    Demolition and rough‑in

    Old shower out, plumbing moved, heating mats wired by an electrician.

  4. 04

    Waterproofing and tile

    Membrane on walls and floor, then tile, niches and benches.

  5. 05

    Glass and walkthrough

    Glass and fixtures installed, then a final walkthrough together.
